name: Chhattisgarh
summary: Known as the 'Rice Bowl of Central India'. Rich in mineral resources (Tin, Coal, Iron Ore). Home to the Chitrakote Falls ('Niagara of India') on the Indravati river.
minerals: Tin ore (sole producer in India), Iron ore (Bailadila), Coal (Korba), Bauxite
monuments: Bhoramdeo Temple, Sirpur Group of Monuments, Chitrakote Falls, Tirathgarh Falls
nationalParks: Indravati National Park, Kanger Valley National Park, Guru Ghasidas National Park
schemes: Mahtari Vandan Yojana, Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana, Mukhyamantri Suposhan Abhiyan

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Chhattisgarh.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Raipur. Chhattisgarh covers a geographic area of 135,192 sq km across 33 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Mahanadi, Indravati, Shivnath, Hasdeo, Rihand.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Known as the 'Rice Bowl of Central India'. Rich in mineral resources (Tin, Coal, Iron Ore). Home to the Chitrakote Falls ('Niagara of India') on the Indravati river.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Chhattisgarh.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Chhattisgarh was formally instituted on 1 November 2000. Official language(s): Chhattisgarhi, Hindi.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Panthi, Raut Nacha, Pandavani, Karma.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Bastar Dussehra, Hareli, Madai Festival.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Chhattisgarh.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Ramen Deka.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Chhattisgarh is Vishnu Deo Sai.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Chhattisgarh High Court (Bilaspur).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Wild water buffalo | State Bird: Bastar hill myna | State Flower: French marigold | State Tree: Sal.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Chhattisgarh.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Tin ore (sole producer in India), Iron ore (Bailadila), Coal (Korba), Bauxite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Chhattisgarh plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Chhattisgarh.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Bhoramdeo Temple, Sirpur Group of Monuments, Chitrakote Falls, Tirathgarh Falls.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Indravati National Park, Kanger Valley National Park, Guru Ghasidas National Park.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Chhattisgarh.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Mahtari Vandan Yojana, Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana, Mukhyamantri Suposhan Abhiyan.
